title: ZephyrBank Infosec Readiness Portfolio - POC Evidence & Control Mapping
content:
Executive summary:

This document aggregates the information and artifacts we assembled for the ZephyrBank POC (Dedicated capacity + VPC peering). Purpose: provide a concise evidentiary portfolio that maps ZephyrBank security questions to concrete artifacts, highlight outstanding gaps, and list the next steps for the upcoming customer audit workshop. This is a working package for the Solutions/Compliance review; portions are redacted or replaced with placeholders where customer-sensitive data is present.

Scope and assumptions:
- Scope: Dedicated Redwood deployment for ZephyrBank (single-tenant GPU pool), VPC peering to ZephyrBank network, short-term POC for feature validation and perf/security review.
- Data types in scope: plaintext customer prompts for demo accounts (tokenized), non-production sample PII (synthetic), logs (access and control plane), and workload telemetry.
- Excluded: production customer data, payment card numbers (no PCI processing in POC).

High-level control mapping (summary):
- Identity & Access Management (IAM): SSO via SAML 2.0, scoped RBAC for operators. Evidence: saml-metadata.xml, access-review-2025-11.pdf, operator-roster.csv (redacted).
- Secrets & Key Management: Customer keys stored in partner KMS; Redwood uses envelope encryption with HSM-backed root keys for Dedicated. Evidence: kms-integration-diagram.png, hsm-usage-logs-20251115.txt (redacted).
- Network & Isolation: VPC peering docs, egress rules, private endpoints, and NAT config. Evidence: vpc-peering-config.txt, subnet-acls-annotated.png, peering-test-pcap.pcap (trace).
- Logging & Monitoring: Centralized logs to customer-forwarded S3, retention configured to 90 days for POC, prometheus + grafana dashboards for metrics. Evidence: logs-sample-redacted.json, grafana-dashboard-export.json.
- Software supply & build: signed model images + deterministic build tags. Evidence: image-signature.asc, build-manifest-commit.txt.
- Incident response: playbook + escalation matrix. Evidence: incident-playbook-v1.docx, runbook-exec-summary.pdf.

Package contents (artifacts included in attached zip):
1) saml-metadata.xml (redacted entityID) - SAML metadata used in SSO exchange.
2) vpc-peering-config.txt - Terraform snippet used to create the peering connection for the POC.
3) hsm-usage-logs-20251115.txt (redacted) - high-level HSM operations: key imports, wrap/unwrap events (timestamps only).
4) logs-sample-redacted.json - access logs with IPs masked.
5) peering-test-pcap.pcap - packet capture showing handshake for peering test (sensitive fields removed).
6) image-signature.asc - GPG signature for the container image used in POC.
7) build-manifest-commit.txt - git commit + artifact checksum.
8) incident-playbook-v1.docx - tailored for ZephyrBank POC.
9) access-review-2025-11.pdf - operator access attestation from solutions team.
10) grafana-dashboard-export.json - telemetry panels for latency, token-per-second, error-rate.

Notes on evidence validity and limitations:
- Several artifacts are intentionally redacted (IP blocks, exact key IDs, customer usernames) to respect PII and contractual restrictions. Where redactions occur we provide a signed hash (sha256) so ZephyrBank can verify integrity once full artifacts are available under NDA.
- HSM logs contain operation codes only; raw key material never leaves HSM and is not present in the package.
- VPC peering was validated in a test window (2025-11-14 03:00–04:00 UTC). The peering-test-pcap shows successful route propagation and TLS handshake; any missing route entries noted below are configuration items to resolve.

Outstanding gaps (items to resolve before final audit):
- Formal penetration test report for the POC environment (scheduled: 2026-01-20). Provide scope and findings to ZephyrBank.
- Customer-required retention policy adjustment for logs longer than 90 days — legal approval pending.
- MFA proof for all operator accounts in the demo environment — currently enforced for SSO but need token validation screenshots.
- Signed BAA/contract addendum for log forwarding to customer-owned S3 (legal draft in linked artifacts).

Action items (owners + rough ETA):
- Marco R.: deliver full HSM audit trail under NDA (ETA: 2026-01-18).
- Priya S.: finalize pen-test scope and onboard third-party vendor (ETA: 2026-01-10).
- Noah L.: produce operator MFA evidence and update access-review doc (ETA: 2026-01-05).
- Asha P.: consolidate final package and sync with ZephyrBank security contact for pre-audit checklist (ETA: 2026-01-12).

Workshop prep notes (for on-site/remote customer session):
- Bring the following artifacts to the workshop workspace (redwood internal drive link + S3 zip under NDA): saml-metadata.xml, vpc-peering-config.txt, incident-playbook-v1.docx, grafana-dashboard-export.json.
- Prep demo steps:
  1) Show VPC peering creation (terraform apply simulation) with route tables and expected route propagation.
  2) Walk through a simulated operator access request, SSO flow with SAML assertion sample.
  3) Show telemetry dashboard highlighting latency and spike handling, then demonstrate fallback to a lower-cost model variant.
  4) Incident playbook walkthrough: detection -> containment -> notification -> postmortem.
- Questions to ask ZephyrBank security team during workshop:
  - Are there additional compliance frameworks beyond SOC2/ISO27001 ZephyrBank wants mapped (e.g., local EU bank regs)?
  - Do they require dedicated HSM tenancy or will a customer-managed KMS suffice for production?
  - Expected retention and egress controls for persisted logs?
  - Network ACL requirements for control-plane communications vs. data-plane (tokenized inference traffic)?

Customer-facing summary (short paragraph to include in email):
Attached is our preliminary infosec readiness portfolio for the ZephyrBank POC. It maps your questionnaire items to concrete artifacts, highlights a small set of outstanding items we will close ahead of the audit workshop, and enumerates the exact artifacts we will share under NDA. We expect to complete the outstanding items by 2026-01-18.

Appendix: quick artifact digest (human-readable entries)
- saml-metadata.xml: contains issuer and certificate thumbprints. Redacted entityID for public sharing.
- vpc-peering-config.txt: Terraform v0.15 snippet (provider: aws), shows peering resource and route table association.
- hsm-usage-logs-20251115.txt: timestamps + operation types only (IMPORT, WRAP, UNWRAP). No key material.
- logs-sample-redacted.json: example of structured access logs; IPs masked to 10.0.x.x equivalents.

If anything in here looks off or incomplete, flag in the ticket JIRA-SEC-9142 or ping #sec-zephyrbank on Slack.

Document history:
- 2025-11-07: initial draft created after POC run.
- 2025-11-20: attached artifacts zip compiled and uploaded to S3.
- 2026-01-05: operator MFA evidence requested; notes appended.
- 2026-01-12: updated outstanding gaps and ETAs (current version).

Redaction & distribution policy:
This file is intended for the internal Redwood security and solutions teams and the ZephyrBank security reviewers under an executed NDA. Do not share outside the approved list.

End of document.
